prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1330; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force of the collision and with the clinical presentation. Examination revealed positive findings on several provocative tests, including pain with resisted abduction and a limited arc of motion, while other tests, including neurovascular assessment and strength testing of the distal extremity, returned within normal limits. No prior injury to the right shoulder is documented in the available history. The patient completed a course of 25 visits consisting of manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home program instruction. Treatment duration was somewhat longer than typically expected for this type of injury, reflecting a gradual but incomplete recovery in range of motion. Billing records reviewed for this episode of care show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services.
